verdict.rationale: Relay documents high-yield savings that earn up to 3.00% APY on idle cash, but nothing in the evidence shows it holds balances in currencies other than USD or pays interest on them. Single-currency savings yield is an adjacent feature, not the multi-currency interest this story asks for. International wires are mentioned only as a transfer method, not as foreign-currency holdings.

support.subject: As a founder, I can earn interest on balances held in multiple currencies
